prompts.prompt: A wide shot of a family of four walking along a gravel path through Djurgården park in Stockholm on a crisp autumn afternoon, golden leaves scattered on the ground, parents holding hands with two young children in colorful jackets, soft natural daylight.

Medium shot of a mother and her seven-year-old daughter standing together at the edge of an indoor ice rink in Stockholm, watching a figure skater in a glittering blue costume glide past them, soft arena lighting reflecting off the polished ice.

A view inside Stockholm's ornate Konsertsalen with parents and small children seated among deep red velvet chairs, a string orchestra tuning on stage under warm chandelier light, gilded balconies and painted ceiling details visible above.

Close-up of a child's small hand gripping a worn wooden railing on the Ericsson Globe Skyview platform, Stockholm harbor and distant islands blurred behind, natural daylight catching the side of the child's smiling face.
